text: OneUptime makes a monitor that checks it every 5 minutes from 2 locations. An incident opens when all of them find it down: no answer, or an answer with an error.
When it goes down, OneUptime opens an incident and pages these people, each the way their How to Reach Me says. It starts with you, by email.
This makes the on-call policy "Default on-call policy", which pages them for every new incident and alert in this project.
Send yourself a test page now. It goes out the way a real page would and every message says TEST. Acknowledge it from the message to finish.
outline: button: Send me a test page

text: If it does not answer, or answers with an error, OneUptime opens an incident (Critical Incident). A status change needs both connected probes to agree.
The on-call policy "Default on-call policy" pages Ada Lovelace for every new incident and alert. You own this monitor, so you are emailed when its status changes.
Ada Lovelace acknowledged it by email after 14 seconds.
